final_fence_definition: The exact final product/test write fence is the set union defined by WRITE_SCOPE_RELEASED_V7.json and the six literal paths listed here; paths already present remain single members. No glob, directory or inferred adjacent path is authorized.
repair_contract: Only actual model normalization transitions mint post-normalization model/envelope hash evidence over the exact stored tuple; persistence remains atomic through the existing transaction.

New transition ledger entries preserve complete received and optional prior-stored JSON claims and computed source/final evidence without asserting received-claim verification; old entries remain byte-preserved.
Changed returned models use guarded commitModel replacement and invalidate old Current/operation/solve/rule/history ownership while preserving returned result/analysis as Historical.
Same-model Historical normalization saves refresh only the still-owned Historical context; a fresh solve wins against delayed refresh.
Same-model Current and unchanged already-current Historical saves preserve their currentness and received carriers; stale status or mismatch alone never appends or repairs.
No model/storage/wire version, hash profile, API or persistence schema change.
evidence_partition: Record native migration integrity source delta and focused evidence separately from analysis/stress evidence. Root owns final native GUI lifecycle, complete review, full sweep and Git.
